verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs list built-in sign-in with Google or Microsoft through OAuth that Floot brokers, so no developer account is needed. That covers the social-provider part of the story. Its docs also say the assistant builds endpoints, tables, and screens for integrations you describe, which only implies that auth screens get scaffolded. Missing for 10: any evidence of email/password sign-up and login, explicit documentation that the builder scaffolds the sign-up and login flows and screens, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Sign in with Google or Microsoft through OAuth that Floot brokers for you — no developer account of your own to register.
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
